title: Ordinary affine pushforward comparison factorization on cohomology
statement: For rings A and B, a ring homomorphism phi : B -> A, an integer i, and a supplied natural isomorphism sigma from restriction of scalars followed by tilde_B to tilde_A followed by ordinary pushforward, assume the latter exact functor preserves zero maps and homology. For every cochain complex C, the defined affinePushforwardCohomologyMapOfComparison equals sigma at H^i(C), followed by the inverse exact homology comparison for tilde_A followed by pushforward, followed by the inverse derived Q/homology comparison, followed by H^i of the actual right-derived pushforward unit on tilde_A(C). No quasi-coherence proof or existential natural transformation is involved.

source.place: Affine morphism equivalence proof, ordinary comparison naturality; ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans and naturality of DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors.inv.

proof.text: Expand affinePushforwardCohomologyMapOfComparison. Naturality of the inverse DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors moves H(Q(sigma_C)) leftwards and replaces it with the ordinary homology map of sigma_C.

Use Mathlib ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans on the degree-i short complex of C: that homology map is the forward exact comparison for F = res_phi followed by tilde_B, sigma at H^i(C), and the inverse comparison for G = tilde_A followed by pushforward. Cancel the adjacent inverse and forward comparisons for F. Associate the remaining factors and identify Scheme.Modules.pushforward with its ringed-space definition. This argument uses neither boundedness nor nonzero rings.

theorem affinePushforwardComparison_factorization
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : B →+* A) (i : ℤ)
    (σ : ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ ⋙ affinePushforwardTilde B ≅
      affinePushforwardTilde A ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
    [(affinePushforwardTilde A ⋙ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    [(affinePushforwardTilde A ⋙ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).PreservesHomology]
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat A) ℤ) :
    affinePushforwardCohomologyMapOfComparison A B φ σ C i =
      σ.hom.app (C.homology i) ≫
        ((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso
          (affinePushforwardTilde A ⋙ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom)).inv ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors
          (SheafOfModules (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i).app
          (((affinePushforwardTilde A ⋙ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj C)).inv ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i).map
          ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
              (((affinePushforwardTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)))
